opening.argument: The presentation leads with a promise of “20x Profit” from a front-running bot and claims users can “passively generate thousands a day.” It then instructs viewers to build and deploy a smart contract, fund it, and activate automated buying and selling. The mechanism is expressly framed as front-running retail investors, while claiming that 90% of proceeds will automatically transfer to the viewer’s wallet. It also requires a minimum of 0.4 BNB and warns that lower amounts “will just burn your funds.” These are concrete directions to commit funds in pursuit of unusually large, passive returns. The contract’s actual behavior, control over the destination of funds, and any completed loss are not independently established, but the combination of return claims, funding instructions, and burn warning supports the alleged scheme.
